name: YouTube

changelog: New features are announced inside the app through tips and notifications.

summary: The YouTube APK is the official Android app for watching videos, Shorts and live streams, subscribing to channels and uploading your own videos. Google Play updated it on November 22, 2026, and the version varies by device. It's free with ads, and YouTube Premium removes ads and adds background play.
metaDescription: YouTube APK download for Android: get the official YouTube app from Google Play, plus Premium vs free, kids settings and fixes when it is not working.

faq.q: How do I download the YouTube APK?
faq.a: YouTube comes preinstalled on almost every Android phone. If it's missing or disabled, install or enable it from Google Play, where the developer is Google LLC. Google doesn't publish YouTube APKs on other sites.
The main YouTube app is rated Teen. For children, use the separate YouTube Kids app, or a supervised YouTube account set up with Google Family Link, which limits content by age.

faq.q: What's the difference between YouTube and YouTube Premium?
faq.a: YouTube is free with ads. YouTube Premium is a paid subscription that removes ads, plays videos in the background and with the screen off, allows downloads, and includes YouTube Music Premium.

faq.q: Why is YouTube not working on my phone?
faq.a: Try switching networks, updating the app from Google Play, and clearing YouTube's cache in Settings → Apps → YouTube → Storage. If it's not working on your TV instead, restart the TV and update its YouTube app.
The YouTube app has no setting to remove Shorts completely. You can tap Not interested on Shorts, use the Take a break reminder, and set a time limit with Android's Digital Wellbeing.
